traditional: No classical doctrine: Uranus is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Identity meets independence and disruption. The urge to be different and to do things your own way. Fused, these drives are difficult to separate and ask to be consciously integrated rather than acted out blindly.

cyclic.meaning: A new cycle of selfhood and disruption is sown: instinctive, full of potential, not yet conscious of itself.

business: Concentrated focus in this area. Suited to independent or innovative work where you aren't boxed in.
shadow: Egotism and needing to be the center fused with instability for its own sake, with no distance to tell them apart.
arcApplying: The two fuse and intensify as they close in.
arcSeparating: The fused theme peaks and discharges.

readerCopy.body: One unexpected resignation, disclosure, or break from the plan can change the public story before leadership has time to prepare the response. Sun conjunct Uranus can make the disruption itself become the new direction, especially when the person at the center decides the old arrangement is no longer worth protecting. The shock may be useful if it exposes a problem everyone was already avoiding. Do not spend the whole response trying to restore the old script. Name what actually changed and what now has to be rebuilt because the break made the previous plan impossible.
